description: This file provides helper functions for outbound message delivery in a QQ bot, including parsing media tags, sending media and text in different formats (markdown/plain), handling media encoding, and managing message chunking and retries.

classes.name: DeliverEventContext
classes.description: Context information about the message delivery event, including message type, sender, and target identifiers.

classes.name: DeliverAccountContext
classes.description: Context information about the bot account, target, and optional logging functions.

classes.name: MediaTargetContext
classes.description: Context for media message targeting, including target type, target ID, and account info.

methods.name: decodeMediaPath
methods.description: Decodes a media path by removing 'MEDIA:', expanding '~', and unescaping octal sequences.

methods.name: sendTextChunks
methods.description: Sends large text messages in chunks, handling retries and quoting references.

methods.name: sendVoiceWithTimeout
methods.description: Sends voice messages with a 45-second timeout guard.

methods.name: sendMarkdownReply
methods.description: Sends a reply in markdown format, handling images, backfilling sizes, and chunking.

methods.name: sendPlainTextReply
methods.description: Sends a plain text reply, including images and chunking.
